verdict.rationale: Companies House publishes its own upfront guidance on "when you need to verify your identity for Companies House", including PSC verification details. It also runs a dedicated identity-verification service separate from the online filing service, so the identity-proofing step is at least stated in advance. The evidence does not show a single pre-start statement listing every account, credential and identity step that stands between a founder and filing. missing for 10: an explicit published enumeration of account-creation and credential requirements (e.g., sign-in accounts or filing codes) before filing, confirmation that all steps are disclosed upfront rather than mid-flow, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
